title: fix(app-shell): show the position's description in the Setup → Positions list
body:
Fixes #25909

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

Setup → Positions now has a **Description** column. The position list in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/builtinComponents.tsx` declared only Name, Label, Holders and Permission sets, so a position's `description`, which `GET /meta/position` already serves, was never shown. The column is `{ key: 'description', label: 'Description' }`, placed right after Label, with no width (it takes the remaining width, like the permission-set list's Description column) and no custom render. The header localizes through the existing `engine.list.col.description` key (en "Description", zh "描述"). A position with no description renders the shared empty cell (`defaultCell` gives `EmptyValue`, an em dash).

The text is the served one. The server overlays `positions.NAME.description` from the translation bundle onto every served position document (`translatePosition`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`), so a translated description shows translated, like the label. The console adds no lookup of its own.

## Tests (head `7a62f956`)

`ResourceListPage.positionGrants-25333.test.tsx` gives `sales_manager` a description and leaves `support_agent` and `auditor` without one. The new case asserts:

- the localized Description header, with Label right before it and Holders right after it;
- the served text in `sales_manager`'s Description cell;
- the shared empty cell (`data-slot="empty-value"`, text exactly the em dash) for the two positions without one.

Red first: the test commit `18603827` ran against the unchanged column list and failed with `Unable to find role="columnheader" and name "Description"` (Tests 1 failed, 5 passed). With the fix (`7a62f956`): Test Files 1 passed, Tests 6 passed.

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the 17 app-shell test files that import `builtinComponents` or render a ResourceListPage with positions: Test Files 17 passed, Tests 135 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`, so the test file is compiled): exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0, manifest intact; `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` untouched.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `7a62f956`: 34 commands, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero, every exit code recorded). `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs` (the roster under `.changeset`): exit 0.
- The full app-shell suite (1730 test files) was not run locally; CI's `Test Core` / UI lanes run it.

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED in a browser: the column was checked in the jsdom render only. The translated description path is the server's overlay, read from source, not measured end to end here.
- No width or truncation on the column, matching the permission-set list. A very long description wraps inside the row, as it already does on that list.
